        r#"  <D:response>
    <D:href>{href}</D:href>
    <D:propstat>
      <D:prop>
        <D:resourcetype>
          <C:calendar-component/>
          <C:vevent/>
        </D:resourcetype>
        <D:getetag>{etag}</D:getetag>
        <D:getcontenttype>text/calendar; charset=utf-8</D:getcontenttype>
      </D:prop>
      <D:status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</D:status>
    </D:propstat>
  </D:response>"#
    )
}

fn render_calendar(
    accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
    principal_id: &str,
    calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
    depth: DavDepth,
    resources: &[(CaldavEventResource, String)],
) -> Response {
    let response = calendar_response_xml(accounts, principal_id, calendar);
    let children = if depth == DavDepth::One {
        resources
            .iter()
            .map(|(resource, etag)| {
                resource_response_xml(principal_id, calendar.calendar_id, resource, etag)
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n")
    } else {
        String::new()
    };
    let body = if children.is_empty() {
        format!(
            r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
{response}
</D:multistatus>"#
        )
    } else {
        format!(
            r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
{response}
{children}
</D:multistatus>"#
        )
    };
    (
        StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS,
        [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/xml; charset=utf-8")],
        body,
    )
        .into_response()
}

fn xml_escape(value: &str) -> String {
    value
        .replace('&', "&")
        .replace('<', "<")
        .replace('>', ">")
        .replace('"', """)
        .replace('\'', "'")
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct CreatePasswordRequest {
    label: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct CreatePasswordResponse {
    server_url: String,
    username: String,
    clear_password: String,
    password: CredentialMetadata,
}

async fn get_apple_connection(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    let status = accounts
        .status(session.user.id)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    Ok(Json(status))
}

async fn create_apple_password(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
    Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
    if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
    }
    let issued = accounts
        .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
        server_url: issued.server_url,
        username: issued.username,
        clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
        password: issued.metadata,
    };
    Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
}

async fn revoke_apple_password(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
    Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    accounts
        .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
        .await
        .map_err(|error| match error {
            CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
            other => map_caldav_error(other),
        })?;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}

async fn disconnect_apple(
    State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
    Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
    accounts
        .revoke_all(session.user.id)
        .await
        .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}

fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
    match error {
        CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
        CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
        CaldavAuthError::ResourceExists | CaldavAuthError::UidConflict => ApiError::internal(),
        CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
    }
}

    async fn assert_options_capabilities(app: Router, uri: &str) {
        let request = Request::builder()
            .method(Method::OPTIONS)
            .uri(uri)
            .body(Body::empty())
            .unwrap();
        let response = app.oneshot(request).await.unwrap();

            dav.to_str().unwrap().contains("calendar-access"),
            "OPTIONS {uri} should advertise calendar-access"
        );

    async fn propfind(
        app: Router,
        uri: &str,
        username: &str,
        password: &str,
        depth: Option<&str>,
    ) -> (StatusCode, String) {
        let mut builder = Request::builder()
            .method(Method::from_bytes(b"PROPFIND").unwrap())
            .uri(uri)
            .header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
        if let Some(depth) = depth {
            builder = builder.header("depth", depth);
        }
        let request = builder.body(Body::empty()).unwrap();
        let response = app.oneshot(request).await.unwrap();
        let status = response.status();
        let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
        (status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
    }

107: fn escape_text(text: &str) -> String {

111:             '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
112:             ';' => out.push_str("\\;"),
113:             ',' => out.push_str("\\,"),
114:             '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
115:             '\r' => out.push_str("\\n"),

122: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
123: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
124:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
125:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
126:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
127:     }
128:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
129:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
130:     let mut pos = 0;
131:     let mut first = true;
132:     while pos < chars.len() {
133:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
134:         let mut end = pos;
135:         while end < chars.len() {
136:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
137:             if segment.len() > width {
138:                 break;
139:             }
140:             end += 1;
141:         }
142:         if end == pos {
143:             end = pos + 1;
144:         }
145:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
146:         if !first {
147:             out.push(' ');
148:         }
149:         out.push_str(&segment);
150:         out.push_str("\r\n");
151:         pos = end;
152:         first = false;
153:     }
154:     out
155: }

343: /// Parse a `sync-collection` REPORT body into its sync token and level.
344: ///
345: /// The `sync-token` element is optional: an absent or empty token requests an
346: /// initial snapshot. The `sync-level` element must be present and equal to 1
347: /// for calendar sync; any other value is rejected.
348: pub fn parse_sync_collection(body: &[u8]) -> Result<SyncCollection, QueryError> {
349:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
350:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
351:     }
352:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
353:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
354:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
355: 
356:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
357:     let mut root_seen = false;
358:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
359:     let mut sync_token: Option<String> = None;
360:     let mut sync_level: Option<u32> = None;
361:     let mut capturing: Option<&'static str> = None;
362:     let mut current = String::new();
363: 
364:     loop {
365:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
366:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
367:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
368:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
369:                 if !root_seen {
370:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
371:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
372:                     }
373:                     root_seen = true;
374:                     depth = 1;
375:                     continue;
376:                 }
377:                 depth += 1;
378:                 if depth == 2 {
379:                     if local == "sync-token" {
380:                         capturing = Some("token");
381:                         current.clear();
382:                     } else if local == "sync-level" {
383:                         capturing = Some("level");
384:                         current.clear();
385:                     }
386:                 }
387:             }
388:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
389:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
390:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
391:                 if !root_seen {
392:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
393:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
394:                     }
395:                     root_seen = true;
396:                     continue;
397:                 }
398:                 depth += 1;
399:                 if depth == 2 && local == "sync-token" {
400:                     // Self-closing sync-token carries no text: initial snapshot.
401:                     sync_token = Some(String::new());
402:                 }
403:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
404:             }
405:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
406:                 if capturing.is_some() {
407:                     current.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
408:                 }
409:             }
410:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
411:                 if let Some(kind) = capturing {
412:                     capturing = None;
413:                     let value = current.trim().to_owned();
414:                     match kind {
415:                         "token" => {
416:                             sync_token = Some(value);
417:                         }
418:                         "level" => {
419:                             sync_level = value.parse::<u32>().ok();
420:                         }
421:                         _ => {}
422:                     }
423:                 }
424:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
425:             }
426:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
427:                 if depth > 0 {
428:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
429:                 }
430:                 break;
431:             }
432:             Ok(_) => {}
433:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
434:         }
435:         buf.clear();
436:     }
437: 
438:     if !root_seen {
439:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
440:     }
441:     let level = sync_level.ok_or(QueryError::BadSyncLevel)?;
442:     if level != 1 {
443:         return Err(QueryError::BadSyncLevel);
444:     }
445:     let token = sync_token.unwrap_or_default();
446:     Ok(SyncCollection {
447:         sync_token: if token.is_empty() { None } else { Some(token) },
448:         sync_level: level,
449:     })
450: }

452: /// Determine the report type from the body and parse it accordingly.
453: pub fn parse_calendar_report(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarReport, QueryError> {
454:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
455:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
456:     }
457:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
458:     let root = peek_root(text).ok_or(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot)?;
459:     match root.as_str() {
460:         "calendar-query" => Ok(CalendarReport::Query(parse_calendar_query(body)?)),
461:         "calendar-multiget" => Ok(CalendarReport::Multiget(parse_calendar_multiget(body)?)),
462:         "sync-collection" => Ok(CalendarReport::SyncCollection(parse_sync_collection(body)?)),
463:         _ => Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot),
464:     }
465: }

467: /// Read the first element name in an XML document, if any.
468: fn peek_root(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
469:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
470:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
471:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
472:     loop {
473:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
474:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
475:                 return Some(name_to_str(start.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
476:             }
477:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
478:                 return Some(name_to_str(empty.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
479:             }
480:             Ok(Event::Eof) => return None,
481:             Ok(_) => {}
482:             Err(_) => return None,
483:         }
484:         buf.clear();
485:     }
486: }
